property_summary: For any target address and value, the reference contract always reverts if the low-level call in sendMoney fails (so the contract balance does not decrease silently), whereas the mutant that removes the require can return successfully leaving the balance unchanged on call failure.
change_summary: Remove the require on the low-level call result so failures in the call do not revert, allowing sendMoney to return without transferring value and leaving contract balance unchanged on call failure.
